alert_summary.description: A failed login followed by a successful login for the same account from an IP address not seen before.

observed_facts: 2026-10-27T09:05:00Z - EP-001: Screen unlocked by local user on LAPTOP-GT-014

notes: same source IP as previous event

supporting_evidence.finding: 1 failed login(s) from 198.51.100.25 followed by a successful login (AUTH-002). This pattern is worth investigating but does not prove compromise.
Successful login from 198.51.100.25 (Brazil), which is not in the known IPs for user101.

conflicting_evidence.finding: Benign activity on registered device LAPTOP-GT-014: Screen unlocked by local user (EP-001).

missing_evidence.finding: MFA result is not recorded for successful login AUTH-002.
No endpoint telemetry after the first successful login, so post-login activity is unknown.

uncertainties: Correlation shows patterns in the retrieved records only. It does not by itself prove an account is compromised.
MFA result is not recorded for successful login AUTH-002.
No endpoint telemetry after the first successful login, so post-login activity is unknown.
recommended_next_checks: Confirm with the account owner, through a verified channel, whether they attempted these logins.
Check the reputation and ownership of the new source IP and whether it is a corporate VPN or proxy.
Retrieve MFA provider logs to see whether MFA was challenged and who approved it.
Pull endpoint telemetry after the login time to check post-login activity.
A human analyst decides on any containment (password reset, session revocation, device isolation). The copilot takes no response actions.
